name: WinRedDestroyer
tagline: Logs repeated political text spam into a case file and drafts the paperwork
description: Builds an evidence file out of repeated political fundraising texts: the send dates, screenshots, repeat STOP requests, and the campaign officers named on public filings. Cases live behind a password, and each one ends in a cease-and-desist letter that you read over and send yourself.
author: valdagher
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
